name: Pytest Automation Tests with Screenplay Pattern

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to run tests'
        required: true
        default: 'dev'
        type: choice
        options:
          - dev
          - qa
          - prod
      marker:
        description: 'Pytest marker to run'
        required: true
        default: 'smoke'
        type: choice
        options:
          - smoke
          - critical
          - regression
          - login
          - all
  schedule:
    # Nightly build - Todos los días a las 2 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.11'
  PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.playwright

jobs:
  # ============================================
  # JOB 1: Setup y Validación
  # ============================================
  setup:
    name: Setup & Verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: |
          playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 🔍 Verify Python version
        run: python --version

      - name: 🔍 Verify Pytest installation
        run: pytest --version

      - name: 🔍 List installed packages
        run: pip list

  # ============================================
  # JOB 2: Smoke Tests (Siempre se ejecutan)
  # ============================================
  smoke-tests:
    name: Smoke Tests
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 📝 Create .env file
        run: |
          echo "ENVIRONMENT=qa" >> .env
          echo "BASE_URL=https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/" >> .env
          echo "USERNAME=student" >> .env
          echo "PASSWORD=Password123" >> .env

      - name: 💨 Run Smoke Tests
        run: |
          pytest -m smoke --alluredir=allure-results -v -s --tb=short
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: 📊 Generate Allure Report
        if: always()
        run: |
          allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: smoke-allure-results
          path: allure-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: smoke-allure-report
          path: allure-report/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 📸 Upload Screenshots
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: smoke-screenshots
          path: |
            *.png
            error_screenshot.png
            debug_screenshot.png
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  # ============================================
  # JOB 3: Critical Tests
  # ============================================
  critical-tests:
    name: Critical Tests
    needs: smoke-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 📝 Create .env file
        run: |
          echo "ENVIRONMENT=qa" >> .env
          echo "BASE_URL=https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/" >> .env
          echo "USERNAME=student" >> .env
          echo "PASSWORD=Password123" >> .env

      - name: 🔴 Run Critical Tests
        run: |
          pytest -m critical --alluredir=allure-results -v -s --tb=short
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: 📊 Generate Allure Report
        if: always()
        run: |
          allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: critical-allure-results
          path: allure-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: critical-allure-report
          path: allure-report/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================
  # JOB 4: Regression Tests (Solo Develop/Main)
  # ============================================
  regression-tests:
    name: Regression Tests
    needs: critical-tests
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 📝 Create .env file
        run: |
          echo "ENVIRONMENT=qa" >> .env
          echo "BASE_URL=https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/" >> .env
          echo "USERNAME=student" >> .env
          echo "PASSWORD=Password123" >> .env

      - name: 🔄 Run Regression Tests
        run: |
          pytest -m regression --alluredir=allure-results -v -s --tb=short -n auto
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: 📊 Generate Allure Report
        if: always()
        run: |
          allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: regression-allure-results
          path: allure-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: regression-allure-report
          path: allure-report/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================
  # JOB 5: Login Tests (Feature específico)
  # ============================================
  login-tests:
    name: Login Feature Tests
    needs: smoke-tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 📝 Create .env file
        run: |
          echo "ENVIRONMENT=qa" >> .env
          echo "BASE_URL=https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/" >> .env
          echo "USERNAME=student" >> .env
          echo "PASSWORD=Password123" >> .env

      - name: 🔐 Run Login Tests
        run: |
          pytest -m login --alluredir=allure-results -v -s --tb=short

      - name: 📊 Generate Allure Report
        if: always()
        run: |
          allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: login-allure-results
          path: allure-results/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: 📤 Upload Allure Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: login-allure-report
          path: allure-report/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================
  # JOB 6: Parallel Tests (Opcional)
  # ============================================
  parallel-tests:
    name: Parallel Tests Matrix
    if: false  # Cambiar a true para habilitar
    needs: setup
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11']
        marker: ['smoke', 'critical', 'login']
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Setup Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: 🎭 Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: 📝 Create .env file
        run: |
          echo "ENVIRONMENT=qa" >> .env
          echo "BASE_URL=https://practicetestautomation.com/practice-test-login/" >> .env
          echo "USERNAME=student" >> .env
          echo "PASSWORD=Password123" >> .env

      - name: 🧪 Run Tests - ${{ matrix.marker }}
        run: |
          pytest -m ${{ matrix.marker }} --alluredir=allure-results -v -s -n auto

      - name: 📤 Upload results - ${{ matrix.marker }}
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: parallel-results-${{ matrix.marker }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: allure-results/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================
  # JOB 7: Publish Allure Report (GitHub Pages)
  # ============================================
  publish-report:
    name: Publish Allure Report
    needs: [smoke-tests, critical-tests, login-tests]
    if: always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Download all Allure results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: '*-allure-results'
          path: allure-results
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: 📊 Generate combined Allure Report
        run: |
          allure generate allure-results -o allure-report --clean

      - name: 🚀 Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./allure-report
          destination_dir: allure-report

  # ============================================
  # JOB 8: Notificaciones y Resumen
  # ============================================
  notify:
    name: Send Notifications
    needs: [smoke-tests, critical-tests, regression-tests, login-tests]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📊 Generate Test Summary
        run: |
          echo "# 🧪 Test Execution Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "## 📋 Details" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Branch:** ${{ github.ref_name }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Triggered by:** ${{ github.event_name }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- **Actor:** ${{ github.actor }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: ✅ Success Notification
        if: success()
        run: |
          echo "## ✅ All Tests Passed!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "All test suites completed successfully." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: ❌ Failure Notification
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "## ❌ Tests Failed!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "One or more test suites failed. Check the logs for details." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      # Opcional: Integración con Slack
      # - name: 📢 Send Slack notification
      #   if: failure()
      #   uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v1
      #   with:
      #     webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
      #     payload: |
      #       {
      #         "text": "❌ Tests failed on ${{ github.ref_name }}",
      #         "blocks": [
      #           {
      #             "type": "section",
      #             "text": {
      #               "type": "mrkdwn",
      #               "text": "*Build Failed*\n*Repository:* ${{ github.repository }}\n*Branch:* ${{ github.ref_name }}\n*Commit:* ${{ github.sha }}\n*Actor:* ${{ github.actor }}"
      #             }
      #           }
      #         ]
      #       }
